description: Cartographie des bornes de WIFI Public sur le territoire de la Ville de Nice is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Métropole Nice Côte d'Azur. Vous trouverez ici les données de cartographie des bornes de WIFI Public sur le territoire de la Ville de Nice. Coverage: Métropole Nice Côte d'Azur. The publisher named on the listing is Métropole Nice Côte d'Azur. Its keywords include nice, wifi, sig, gratuit, cartographie, internet. The listing shows 6 download or service links in ZIP, KMZ, GEOJSON, JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
